stage0100a_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$スズネ$$
「We really made it back, didn't we...」

stage0100a_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$スズネ$$
「We'll soon reach the point where the Prison of Time is destroyed...
　That's when the wall separating our world from the dimensions around it
　will start to collapse」

stage0100a_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$甲児$$
「Come on, show some more joy, $n.
　We're coming home with victory in hand」

stage0100a_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$甲児$$ is correct.
　Once we witness the Prison of Time's
　complete destruction, our fight ends here」

stage0100a_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$アルト$$
「You might not feel it quite yet,
　but once you see that, you'll feel
　the victory for real」

stage0100a_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「But it's true that things will still
　be difficult from here on」

stage0100a_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$バナージ$$
「It's the problem between Earth
　and the colonies, isn't it」

stage0100a_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ファ$$
「Chrono's probably lost his power by now,
　so I don't think Earth supremacists will
　rise to power again, but...」

stage0100a_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$フォウ$$
「That's right.
　Neo Zeon's lost the Red Comet too,
　so their momentum will fall off as well」

stage0100a_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$エマ$$
「After that, if the moderates in the
　Federation solve things peacefully,
　the Earth Sphere will grow peaceful too」

stage0100a_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$カツ$$
「This is where the Earth Federation's
　real start begins, isn't it」

stage0100a_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I think that future is a bright one」

stage0100a_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$リディ$$
「It'd be nice if things really went
　that smoothly」

stage0100a_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$リディ$$
「I was just stating the reality of it」

stage0100a_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Haven't we been fighting to somehow
　get past that reality and make our
　ideals come true」

stage0100a_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$アムロ$$
（$$リディ$$'s inner darkness...
　it doesn't look shallow）

stage0100a_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$クェス$$
「I knew it, you're still worried
　about Neo Zeon, aren't you?」

stage0100a_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$シャア$$
「More than Zeon, it's the future
　of the colonies...」

stage0100a_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$シャア$$
「$$ハマーン$$ will bring them together...
　All a fallen Red Comet can do
　is believe in that」

stage0100a_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Seems like you've had your fill
　of being a symbol」

stage0100a_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$アムロ$$
「But you're not like me.
　When that time comes, you might have
　to come out into the open again」

stage0100a_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Not as Zeon's Red Comet, though,
　but as one man, $$シャア・アズナブル$$」

stage0100a_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$シャア$$
（$$フル・フロンタル$$...
　It seems the singularity affected him
　even more strongly than it did me）

stage0100a_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$シャア$$

　if that man is still alive, what would
　he seek beyond it...）

stage0100a_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$シャア$$

　I saw...）

stage0100a_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$シン$$
「With Chrono and Neo Zeon losing steam,
　I hope $$プラント$$'s calls to keep fighting
　die down too, but...」

stage0100a_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$キラ$$
「The mood hanging over $$プラント$$...
　I don't think that's just from
　Neo Zeon's influence」

stage0100a_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「An air of heading toward war... huh」

stage0100a_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$マリー$$
「People's hatred gathers together,
　forming a current nothing can stop...」

stage0100a_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Even Celestial Being was investigating
　$$プラント$$'s movements, but there was a
　peculiar mood we couldn't quite explain...」

stage0100a_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$デュオ$$
「$$アスラン$$ and $$ルナマリア$$ are on it
　over there, right? Let's wait
　and see what they do first」

stage0100a_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$シン$$
「That's right, $$キラ$$.
　People all over the world chose
　this future. I'm sure it'll work out」

stage0100a_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$五飛$$
「Do you think what $$シン$$ said is
　wishful thinking?」

stage0100a_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「If a future where that doesn't happen
　comes to pass, I'll simply fight it」

stage0100a_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$カトル$$
「That's right.
　The world moves forward into
　the future... Let's help it along」

stage0100a_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Come on, $$五飛$$.
　Don't get all sulky on us now」

stage0100a_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「Both $$ヒイロ$$ and $$五飛$$ seem to have
　grown stronger through this fight」

stage0100a_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$刹那$$
「The same goes for the world.
　I want to believe that, at least...」

stage0100a_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「We of Celestial Being will keep
　fighting for that world as well」

stage0100a_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「That's right.
　The eradication of war through
　dialogue... That's our final goal」

stage0100a_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$刹那$$
（Quanta...
　For that, too, I have to finish it...）

stage0100a_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$葵$$
「A world with the Prison of Time
　destroyed, huh...」

stage0100a_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$くらら$$
「A world where the dimensional boundary
　is unstable... In other words, there's a
　chance visitors from other worlds could reappear」

stage0100a_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Might not just be new encounters,
　could be reunions too」

stage0100a_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「That's right.
　We might get to see the members of
　$$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ and $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ again too」

stage0100a_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「Thinking about it that way,
　there's some anxiety, but there's
　a lot to look forward to as well」

stage0100a_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$葵$$
「I wonder if my senior's out there
　in some world somewhere too...」

stage0100a_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$葵$$
「Calling them the original Team D
　is probably the easiest way
　to put it...」

stage0100a_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$くらら$$
「Only their machines and pilots
　were the ones who transferred
　into this world」

stage0100a_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Not a fusion on the scale of
　whole worlds, but transfers of
　individuals, huh...」

stage0100a_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Well, if you put it that way,
　we're pretty much the same」

stage0100a_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$アンディ$$
「That's true.
　From our world, only the area around
　$$聖天使学園$$ and a few other spots made it over here」

stage0100a_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「I've already gotten used to it,
　so I hadn't really thought about
　it much, but...」

stage0100a_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Come to think of it, isn't the way
　we got transferred here a pretty
　rare case?」

stage0100a_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$モロイ$$
「Not just us, but the fact the
　legendary Mythical Aquarion got
　sent flying here too was a surprise」

stage0100a_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「What are you going to do
　from here, $$カグラ$$?」

stage0100a_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Let's see...
　If I can open a dimensional gate,
　maybe I'll head back to Altair once...」

stage0100a_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ジン$$
「That's assuming they'll actually
　accept you over there, though」

stage0100a_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ジン$$
「Just kidding, $$カグラ$$.
　If that happens, I'll go back
　with you too」

stage0100a_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Now that we know how to save Altair
　from Eve's curse, this time I want to go
　to where $$ジン$$ was born, not to fight」

stage0100a_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$クレア$$
「It's not just $$ジン$$ and $$ユノハ$$
　The worlds and people we met across
　the multiverse will find harmony and build a new future」

stage0100a_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$アマタ$$
「That's something $$ミコノ$$'s power to bind taught me」

stage0100a_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$アマタ$$
「And $$ミコノ$$ taught me
　how wonderful it is to love someone」

　I learned from you, $$アマタ$$」

stage0100a_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$モーム$$
「I wonder if we can go back to
　the $$ファクトリー$$ too...」

stage0100a_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$桂$$
「We're the ones branded with the $$烙印$$, right?
　And on top of that, I'm the singularity
　of the $$大時空震動$$」

stage0100a_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$桂$$
「No telling when I might get caught up
　in a $$時空震動$$ again and get sent
　flying off somewhere」

stage0100a_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$モーム$$
「Even so, $$モーム$$ will stay with
　Master $$桂$$」

stage0100a_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$モーム$$
「$$モーム$$ will always stay by
　Master $$桂$$'s side. If Master $$桂$$
　gets caught up in a $$時空震動$$, $$モーム$$ will go too」

stage0100a_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$モーム$$
「So please, don't say such sad things...」

stage0100a_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$モーム$$
「No...!
　Keeping Master $$桂$$ energetic is my job, after all!」

stage0100a_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$モーム$$ really is a devoted one」

stage0100a_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$桂$$
「Want $$ドロシー#240$$ to take a page from her?」

stage0100a_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「No...
　$$ドロシー#240$$ suits me just fine」

stage0100a_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「Words I don't usually hear from you...
　Are you giddy over the victory?」

stage0100a_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$ロジャー$$
（But a question remains.
　Just what did $$ガドライト$$ have his
　eye on Earth for...?）

stage0100a_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$ロジャー$$
（And the $$烙印$$, mark of being tossed
　about by $$時空震動$$... Does whoever
　carved it exist somewhere...）

stage0100a_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Now that you mention it, maybe I am
　a little tired」

stage0100a_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「That's fine.
　For now, just enjoy this short vacation」

stage0100a_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「You're right. But as long as the world
　goes on, a negotiator like me will
　always be needed」

stage0100a_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I'll keep moving forward with the world too.
　That's my pride as a professional」

stage0100a_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Major $$オズマ$$ and the others' Frontier fleet
　is setting out for the galaxy, right?」

stage0100a_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Could you take me and $$ガンバスター$$
　along on that journey too?」

stage0100a_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$オズマ$$
「If you register as a citizen of the fleet,
　I don't think there'd be a problem, but...」

stage0100a_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$アルト$$
「Is that all right, $$ノリコ$$?」

stage0100a_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「I may not look it, but I've been
　to the galaxy's core myself, you know」

stage0100a_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Yeah... When the universe is reborn
　at the end of the 12,000-year cycle, if
　space monsters... $$バアル$$, swarm in droves...」

stage0100a_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'll fight them to protect Earth...
　Because that's the duty of the one
　entrusted with $$ガンバスター$$」

stage0100a_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$カナリア$$
「It's a bit late to be telling you this,
　but it'll be a tougher journey than
　you imagine」

stage0100a_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「With no one like $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ or $$ミカゲ$$
　around anymore, I don't think $$バアル$$'s
　coming to Earth again anytime soon...」

stage0100a_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$クラン$$
「Unlike Earth, peaceful for now,
　a journey to the galaxy is like diving
　headfirst into danger」

stage0100a_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「But the fleet's leaving anyway, right?」

stage0100a_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$アルト$$
「Yeah... No matter what dangers there
　might be, we decided to move forward,
　and the Frontier fleet and the other fleets left Earth」

stage0100a_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$アルト$$
「Those of us who grew up there
　always carry that feeling too」

stage0100a_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Look at you talk, $$アルト$$」

stage0100a_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$アルト$$
「You're not the only one with something
　in his heart he won't budge on」

stage0100a_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Let me hear it, then -
　your soul, with the galaxy as its stage」

stage0100a_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Seems it's finally time for Fire Bomber

$$ミサト$$
「Good work, up till today, $$シンジ$$.
　And you too, $$レイ#333$$」

stage0100a_03:r_60e4d2ebcfd943ea.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Once we see the Prison of Time destroyed,
　let's think about what comes next together」

stage0100a_03:r_c0837a2b98000559.text:
$$ミサト$$
「That's right.
　It's not even certain whether Angels will keep appearing, after all」

stage0100a_03:r_65ef57e28bd90298.text:
$$シンジ$$
「If you were told you could do as you liked,
　what would you do, Ayanami?」

stage0100a_03:r_bbc100b0424fdcd0.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「Because all I can do is pilot EVA」

stage0100a_03:r_03d92655c99f7c70.text:
$$シンジ$$
「What if the Angels never appear again?」

stage0100a_03:r_d9ad0726bf16dd92.text:
$$シンジ$$
「So let's look for it together.
　A way of living after getting off EVA」

stage0100a_03:r_ce4ee5d4d2a4dc1d.text:
$$マリ$$
「Well... maybe now's not the time to spoil the mood...」

stage0100a_03:r_01fea60fea66c996.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「What are you planning to do, $$キリコ$$?」

stage0100a_03:r_48a3f23147fd6b6d.text:
$$キリコ$$
「All I can do is fight」

stage0100a_03:r_28066ae0934e6411.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「So $$キリコ$$, that means you'll be
　continuing your contract with $$ミスリル$$」

stage0100a_03:r_a38016b9c3d59e6e.text:
$$マオ$$
「Once we're back, a showdown with Amalgam awaits.
　We'll be plenty busy」

stage0100a_03:r_258a09e5e9761e3d.text:
$$クルツ$$
「It's exhausting, isn't it.
　One fight ends, and there's already another one waiting」

stage0100a_03:r_4a301748a7930689.text:
$$ゼロ$$
（$$キリコ$$...
　Do you sense a new battle coming too...）

stage0100a_03:r_c38e739de7ee864a.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「That man, and you as well, are both caught in an inescapable fate」

stage0100a_03:r_fb06b0a658b1ef40.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「But if it stands in the way of
　where I and the world are headed,
　I'll simply crush it」

stage0100a_03:r_8f39e18936c36a15.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Don't get it wrong, $$スザク$$.
　I am Zero, forever」

stage0100a_03:r_f2655371e3ef7b59.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
（Seems like my help isn't needed anymore...）

stage0100a_03:r_ee7f46e6a631fd5c.text:
$$カレン$$
「What are you talking about, $$ゼロ$$?」

stage0100a_03:r_959b2fde0469959d.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「...It's a matter on my end.
　$$カレン$$... you think about
　the Volunteer Club's future」

stage0100a_03:r_54d7a668750123ea.text:
$$カレン$$
「I see...
　So we get to go back to Jindai High」

stage0100a_03:r_586ac0e9503b5765.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Though everyone in the Volunteer Club is
　in trouble when it comes to moving up a grade」

stage0100a_03:r_dc37213133cd8177.text:
$$アルト$$
「Is that true, Miss $$スズネ$$!?」

stage0100a_03:r_9b8d839e83da7879.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I-it's fine!
　The Volunteer Club's achievements are
　recognized, and if I take makeup classes after this...」

stage0100a_03:r_c2a5e2a9019026a4.text:
$$甲児$$
「What kind of unreliable answer is that?」

stage0100a_03:r_855e82ce06693ee8.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I'm sorry...
　My own attendance for the practicum
　isn't enough, and it's become a problem...」

stage0100a_03:r_3c1c81e93f697fb9.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「A confession, of all things, at a time like this!」

stage0100a_03:r_10cbf30c54cfe4fc.text:
$$ボス$$
「D-don't tell me the Volunteer Club
　and Miss $$スズネ$$ are all getting
　held back a year together!?」

stage0100a_03:r_d84831042f10325c.text:
$$宗介$$
「One trouble ends, only for another to begin...!」

stage0100a_03:r_fa54b106906131ec.text:
$$かなめ$$
「We've made it through every crisis
　somehow, up till now, haven't we」

stage0100a_03:r_64f86b30363f1f4c.text:
$$かなめ$$
「So I'm sure it'll be fine this time too」

stage0100a_03:r_afa4e4bac1376010.text:
$$宗介$$
「But when you say it,
　it feels like anything's possible,
　even with no basis at all」

stage0100a_03:r_b0aaf075b2a97a36.text:
$$かなめ$$
「T-$$テッサ$$... you came to the $$ラー・カイラム$$...」

stage0100a_03:r_53add6e443d8a65a.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Is there some problem with me being here?」

stage0100a_03:r_d95bdcd1bd8b6579.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Honestly...
　There's no letting your guard down,
　not even an opening」

stage0100a_03:r_d3ea963a3518a978.text:
$$かなめ$$
「N-never mind!
　Don't worry about it!」

stage0100a_03:r_0c888ad00ef30dc4.text:
$$アルト$$
「Looks like this fight's still got a ways to go」

stage0100a_03:r_bee2bfb994ca7365.text:
$$宗介$$
「But for now, the enemy we must fight is advancing a grade」

stage0100a_03:r_6d287e4652a3781f.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Alright, everyone!
　Let's unite and do our best against the danger of being held back!」

stage0100a_03:r_1c42d2bca3a5e3a3.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Aren't you going to the Volunteer Club's departure ceremony?」

stage0100a_03:r_2488b984097a7bdf.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's a bit late to bring this up, but
　I think the $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$ was, after all,
　a machine built to steal $$ジェミニア$$'s $$スフィア$$」

stage0100a_03:r_6acc4cacd2cf56b6.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Intentional convergent evolution...
　In other words, they were given
　the same shape to carry the same properties」

stage0100a_03:r_131bea3d5d957e98.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Who knows...
　That's a matter for the higher-ups at $$ＤＥＭ$$...」

stage0100a_03:r_fc994d6aae0712cc.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, once the Prison of Time is destroyed,
　I'll be able to contact $$ＤＥＭ$$ myself.
　That should solve this mystery too」

stage0100a_03:r_ae2ea53f43e74074.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Is it because your revenge ended
　when you defeated $$ガドライト$$?」

stage0100a_03:r_d4164c459c1c1165.text:
$$スズネ$$
「So, what will you do from here on?」

stage0100a_03:r_f794dabe545dc6ac.text:
$$スズネ$$
「The revenge that started your fight is over...
　And you've made it back to Earth like this...
　Will you go back to being an ordinary high schooler?」

stage0100a_03:r_59cb6a337266e5c9.text:
$n
「If piloting $$ジェニオン$$ means I can protect something,
　I'll keep fighting」

stage0100a_03:r_3888ccd5f98dd99d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Oh, come on... isn't that 'we', not 'I'?」

stage0100a_03:r_aab85855cbaf5596.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Of course. I don't intend to fail my credits
　and be a college student again next year」

stage0100a_03:r_e5f4d0fca11502fa.text:
$$スズネ$$
「My theme is balancing everyday life
　and fighting. Of course, $n's going
　to keep me company with that too」

stage0100a_03:r_47fd2ac2e2a8e945.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Until the day I get my glasses back, nice to be working with you again」

stage0100a_03:r_95ef381ed0b96982.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...And with that warm mood in place,
　deep down, you still have doubts, don't you, $n?」

stage0100a_03:r_82218191e135e576.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Whether that $$ガドライト$$ really was
　the angel, your family's enemy...」

stage0100a_03:r_2471e14c1ef0ecac.text:
$n
「I don't know...
　A chill suddenly ran through my whole body...」

stage0100a_03:r_c5d536c5ba8c0902.text:
$$アムロ$$
「An anomaly in the dimensional boundary
　was observed around the collapse point
　of the Prison of Time!」

stage0100a_03:r_243595675818fcae.text:
$$アムロ$$
「We're launching, in case the worst happens!」

stage0100a_03:r_61c5480dbf2e58e0.text:
$$スズネ$$
「An anomaly in the dimensional boundary...」
